title: Sion Paradiananta
chord: E · G · Am · F · C · G · F · E
lyrics:
Sion Paradiananta, dao ma holsoholsomu
Ai didok Tuhanta Jesus dame, dame di hamu
Tung pasonang pingkiranmu, Ai donok Rajanta i
Holan na managamnagam boi ditopot Jesus i
Salpu ma naung binolusan, pir tondim di na naeng ro
Sangkapmi nang pangidoan, Sahat tu Jesusmu do
